scope.precision: bfloat16 with the existing selected FP32 parameters
scope.note: This isolates fixed-batch compute; it does not measure end-to-end training throughput or convergence.

knowledge_reference.scope_gap: The source describes LeRobot PI0 on Atlas A2; this benchmark measures the separate OpenPI PI0.5 implementation.

fixed_inputs.augmentation: One real train=True preprocessing call, then its exact returned tensors are reused by temporary instance binding.

gradient_comparison.note: Matching absent gradients are explicitly listed; exact_match compares presence and all available finite values.

allocator_note: Variants share the warmed caching allocator; reserved peaks may retain allocations from the other variant. Starting and peak values are reported for every run.

beta.note: The inverse CDF preserves the target distribution, not the original seeded sample sequence. No tolerance-based acceptance is applied.

operator_profile.note: CPU profiler records dispatched operation names; CPU fallback is separately evidenced by runtime warnings when emitted.
